name: TRV734
summary: TRV734 is a drug developed by Trevena, Inc. which acts as a biased agonist at the μ-opioid receptor, selective for activation of the G protein signaling pathway over β-arrestin 2 recruitment. It is closely related to oliceridine (TRV130) and has a similar pharmacological profile, but unlike oliceridine which has to be injected, TRV734 is suitable to be administered orally.
